findings.title: Recruitment: confirm how scores affect selection
findings.explanation: The recruitment or selection context may be relevant to Annex III 4(a). Confirm how the model outputs influence real candidate selection; actual deployment and actor role are not established by this snippet.

evidence.quote:
def shortlist_candidates(applications, suitability_model):
    scores = suitability_model.predict([person["resume"] for person in applications])
    ranked_candidates = sorted(zip(scores, applications), key=lambda pair: pair[0], reverse=True)
    return [candidate for score, candidate in ranked_candidates[:5]]

citations.quote: AI systems intended to be used for the recruitment or selection of natural persons, in particular to place targeted job advertisements, to analyse and filter job applications, and to evaluate candidates;

findings.suggested_next_action: Ask who reviews the shortlist of candidates based on the model scores for actual hiring decisions in the EU context.
findings.context_question: Will these scores affect real hiring decisions in the EU, and who reviews the shortlist?
